# Manim Studio

A free, open-source local creative studio powered by Manim Community.
No account is needed. Projects and assets are kept on the user's computer.

- Overview: https://manimgui.birol.tech/
- Templates: https://manimgui.birol.tech/templates.html
- Image filters: https://manimgui.birol.tech/shaders.html
- Batch creation and sound: https://manimgui.birol.tech/workflows.html
- Python scene editor: https://manimgui.birol.tech/author.html
- AI connections: https://manimgui.birol.tech/ai.html
- Installation and setup: https://manimgui.birol.tech/get-started.html
- Source: https://github.com/birol-dev/Manim-Fullstack

Templates cover countdowns, intervals, comparisons, charts, counters, announcements,
celebrations, quotes, and quizzes. Export MP4, GIF, WebM, MOV, or PNG, in landscape,
vertical, square, and portrait layouts. Batch creation accepts CSV, TSV, and XLSX,
or pasted lists, with up to 200 variations. Music and effects can be added to video;
PNG and GIF are silent.

The website's live image playground demonstrates seven image filters on a nature
photograph: Fluted Glass, Lens Distortion, Water, Paper Texture, Halftone Dots,
Halftone CMYK, and Image Dithering. It exports PNG. The app adds image uploads,
more controls, and short WebM recordings. Live shaders need WebGL 2.

Author mode provides a Python editor, live rendering progress, a timeline, render
comparison, and an asset library. Compatible AI clients can connect over MCP to
find templates, edit projects, inspect storyboards, and queue exports. AI clients
may send information to their provider according to their own settings.

Windows desktop packages include the template runtime. Source setup needs Python
3.11+ and Node.js 20.19+ for the initial build; macOS and Linux need Cairo and Pango.
